SEO_KEYWORDS: local whisper, browser transcription, private transcription, macwhisper windows alternative, offline whisper, pwa whisper, webgpu whisper, srt export browser
HERO_HEADLINE: Private transcription that never leaves your browser.
HERO_SUBHEAD: Drop an audio file → get SRT, VTT, or TXT. Runs Whisper locally via WebGPU / WASM. Install as a PWA and use offline. Free tier ships watermark; $19 one-time unlocks batch mode + SRT/VTT export.
HERO_MICRO_PROOF: Works on Chrome, Edge, Arc, Firefox (WASM fallback). Model downloads once (~40 MB), caches in IndexedDB, then works offline.
PROBLEM_STATEMENT: MacWhisper is $19 and gorgeous — and macOS-only. Windows and Linux users get shoved to cloud services that upload their audio to someone else's box, or to command-line whisper.cpp that requires a Python setup. Local Whisper Web is the missing middle: same private, offline transcription, in a web app you install like an app. Zero setup, zero upload, zero surveillance.
FEATURE_1_BODY: Audio decodes in-browser. Model runs in-browser (WebGPU when available, WASM fallback). Nothing is uploaded — inspect the network tab to verify.
FEATURE_2_BODY: PWA with service worker. Install on Windows, macOS, Linux, or ChromeOS in one click. Works fully offline after the first model download.
FEATURE_3_BODY: Free tier exports TXT with a small watermark line. Pro unlocks SRT, VTT, JSON with word-level timestamps, and batch (drop a whole folder).

FAQ_1_A: Yes. Open your browser devtools, watch the Network tab, drop a file. You will see model weight downloads from Hugging Face on first run (or from your service worker cache after that). Zero requests carry your audio anywhere. If we ever change that we will announce it loudly and give a refund window.
FAQ_2_A: Chrome, Edge, Arc, Opera (WebGPU path — fastest). Firefox, Safari (WASM path — 3-5× slower but still real-time on tiny/base). Mobile browsers work but are slow; use desktop for anything over a minute of audio.
FAQ_3_Q: How is this different from MacWhisper / WhisperTranscribe / cloud services?
FAQ_3_A: MacWhisper is macOS-only and native. WhisperTranscribe and every cloud service upload your audio. This is the only local, private, cross-platform, install-like-an-app option. If you're on macOS and happy with MacWhisper, use MacWhisper — this is for the 60% of the world on Windows or Linux.
FAQ_4_A: Free tier: whisper-tiny (~39M params, ~40MB) and whisper-base (~74M params, ~140MB). Pro: whisper-small (~244M, ~460MB) and whisper-medium (~769M, ~1.5GB). All ONNX-quantized via Xenova/transformers.js. Model weights are MIT-licensed by OpenAI + Xenova conversions.
